variants.notes: VERIFICATION: material part bit-exact; engine tail replaced by UE translucency lighting (approximation). The port (WuwaToonCommonTransConstMRNoNMap2S, WuwaToonBasePass_CommonTrans.ush) returns the material values (Emissive, Opacity, toon lit colour, and the Kuro toon-lighting inputs shadow colour / shadow / shadow AO / normal); bit-exact through the whole original o0 with those registers overwritten (identity, isolation and negative controls above). Not ported (engine tail): primitive fade, vertex / volumetric height fog, emissive scale and OOB stripes, Kuro forward toon lighting (screen shadow mask / CSM, local-light list), pre-exposure. In UE the spec is "resolve": false with the lit-translucent template (DefaultLit, BLEND_Translucent, TwoSided): Emissive -> Emissive Color, Opacity -> Opacity, OutBaseColor -> Base Color, lit by UE translucency lighting. No scene colour / scene depth is read. VS: VS #94642 = the verified Common Body VS #35700 on TEXCOORD2 / SV_POSITION (symbolic equivalence after slot renaming and removal of its vertex height-fog block L263-L860, which no compared output depends on); WuwaToonBaseVS_LightDir + WuwaToonBaseVS_WPO.
